usage: tunnel requests show [-h] [--base BASE] [--json] [--raw] seq

positional arguments:
  seq          the seq from `tunnel requests --each`

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --base BASE  where the admin API answers (default http://127.0.0.1:8000)
  --json       print raw JSON, errors included, for piping into jq
  --raw        print header values instead of [REDACTED]
